---
name: New thinking model
about: Propose a thinking model — accepted only if it brings its failure boundary
title: "[model] "
labels: new-model
---

> A model without a stated **failure boundary** is not added. That column is the entire value of the library — see [CONTRIBUTING](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Name and origin** (cite if it is not yours)

**Side**

- [ ] `H` — changes how the user asks / interacts
- [ ] `M` — shapes how the model reasons (silent, never narrated)

**Mode**

- [ ] `wrap` — adds constraints around the question
- [ ] `inject` — silent, shapes reasoning only
- [ ] `interactive` — becomes a dialogue, consent asked first

**One-line principle** (mechanism, not marketing)

<!-- Good: "Explaining out loud exposes gaps in internal consistency — the stall reveals the hole."
     Bad:  "Unlock deeper understanding." -->

**Trigger** — the observable signal that should select it

**Failure boundary** — when using this is worse than not using it. This is mandatory.

**Overlap check** — which existing model is closest, and why both should exist

<!-- See skill/references/thoughts.md for the current 25. -->

**Would you add it as a scenario default?** If so, which scenario, and what does it displace?
